name: newcodexJS/10-inventory-management
top_fix: De-clone: this course is 97.7% character-identical to 09-job-application-tracker's (and 07/08's); keep one of the four and rewrite the rest around domain-specific invariants, and fix the six identical 'Boundary 1..6' paragraphs in 07-TRACE-LAB.md that all point at services/service.ts:parsePayload.
summary: Real fix: zod create/partial-update schema with trimmed, bounded, case-insensitively deduplicated tags; a broken whereRaw("CAST(products AS TEXT) ILIKE ?") search replaced by per-column orWhereILike; id tie-break on the list sort; explicit JSON.stringify of tags before insert/update; 404 instead of undefined on update/delete of a missing row. 4 real HTTP tests against a disposable Postgres schema, matching logs/61-tests.log exactly. All 42 code excerpts verified verbatim against source. Loses points because it is one of a four-project noun-swapped clone family and VERIFICATION.md's 'Tested behavior' misquotes the fixture ("Revised lesson" vs "Revised fixture", "numeric sku" vs an object).

name: newcodexJS/11-survey-builder
top_fix: Rewrite 07-TRACE-LAB.md 'Boundary 1..6', currently six byte-identical paragraphs all pointing at surveyService.submitResponse, so each boundary names its own file; and tighten surveyValidators.ts start_date/end_date to z.string().datetime() so an unparseable window cannot silently disable the capacity/date check.
summary: submitResponse now opens a transaction, takes SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the survey row and re-checks status/start_date/end_date/max_responses inside the lock; buildAnswerRows became a per-question-type validator (unknown question IDs, unknown choice labels, out-of-range ratings, matrix rows/columns, ISO dates, 20k text cap) that stores blank-but-optional as null rather than 0. The three tests are real HTTP against a throwaway Postgres schema and one is a genuine Promise.all race on max_responses=1 asserting [201,400] plus response_count===1. Best concurrency lesson in the batch; chapters 04/05/07 are shared boilerplate.

name: newcodexJS/12-chat-polling
top_fix: Fix the 500-instead-of-400 in the new guard: chatRouter.use reads req.body.messageId before validateBody(readSchema) runs, so POST /conversations/:id/read with an empty body hands Knex an undefined binding and errorMiddleware turns the non-AppError into a 500. Guard the branch or move validation ahead of the membership check, and add a test.
summary: One router-level guard replaces 19 unguarded routes: it resolves /messages/:id to its conversation, requires a conversation_members row for the demo user, scopes the admin role to that membership row, validates that a read receipt's messageId belongs to the conversation, and returns 404 rather than 403 so existence does not leak. Group creation deduplicates memberIds. Three real HTTP tests drive five routes as an outsider, a plain member and an admin. Best authorization lesson in the batch; residual TOCTOU is honestly disclosed.

name: newcodexJS/13-ecommerce-storefront
top_fix: Rewrite 07-TRACE-LAB.md 'Boundary 1..6' (six identical paragraphs all pointing at storeService.checkout) and add a two-column A/B transaction sketch to 02-CONCEPTS.md explaining the deadlock that checkout's orderBy("id").forUpdate() prevents - Exercise 3 asks learners to test it but nothing explains it first.
summary: Fixes a genuine oversell: the old addToCart compared the incremental quantity against stock while the SQL upsert added it to the existing cart quantity. changeCartQuantity now computes the cumulative quantity under a cart+product row lock; checkout locks the cart, then every cart product ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE, rechecks is_active and stock, and commits order + order_items + stock decrement + cart clear in one transaction. Three real HTTP tests including a two-buyer race and a failure-injection test that installs a Postgres BEFORE INSERT trigger on order_items and then asserts stock and cart are untouched. Best transactions lesson in the batch.

name: newcodexJS/14-appointment-booking
top_fix: Make the status coupling explicit: ensureNoConflict only searches status:"confirmed", so the overlap invariant depends entirely on appointmentService.ts:125 setting status confirmed on create. Parameterize the slot-holding statuses or document the coupling in 03-WORKED-CHANGE.md, and add a test for a pending appointment.
summary: createAppointment and updateAppointment now run in a transaction that locks the provider_profiles row FOR UPDATE before testing overlaps with a correct half-open interval (start < end AND end > start, 409 ConflictError), and the booking-confirmed notification row is inserted inside the same transaction. Three real HTTP tests against a disposable Postgres schema: a two-request race for one slot, a conflicting reschedule that asserts the original start_time is untouched, and a failure-injection test using a Postgres trigger on notifications to prove the booking rolls back. Clearest transaction-boundary lesson in the batch.

name: newcodexJS/15-api-tester
top_fix: Add a section to 02-CONCEPTS.md justifying the owner-row lock (all three environment writers begin with trx("users").where({id:userId}).forUpdate()), what it costs, and two alternatives - a Postgres partial unique index on (user_id) WHERE is_active, or locking the user's environment rows in ID order. As written the course teaches a coarse pattern with no stated boundary.
summary: Fixes a real verify-then-mutate bug: the old activateEnvironment cleared is_active on all the user's rows BEFORE trying to activate the target, so a foreign or nonexistent ID left the user with zero active environments. The new code reads the target, 404s, and only then clears flags, all inside a transaction serialized on the owner row. replaceVariables rejects duplicate trimmed keys before deleting, so a rejected replacement preserves the prior set; PUT [] is treated as a legitimate clear. Saved-request headers/params are JSON.stringify-ed into JSONB in both seeds and CRUD. Four real HTTP tests including a concurrent double activation. Domain is developer tooling, so elective rather than core.

name: newcodexJS/16-team-project-management
top_fix: Keep this one as the archive/restore/bulk-audit lesson and delete or stub astraupskill/ in projects 17, 18, 19 and 20 - all five ship the same 8.4k words with nouns swapped (all nine files 96-99% character-identical). Also delete the dead status:"active" argument in restoreRecord, which lifecycleUpdate unconditionally overwrites and which is not even in this project's allowedStatuses.
summary: Additive migration 003_archive_status.ts stores status_before_archive; lifecycleUpdate locks the row, makes repeat archive/restore no-ops and restores the saved prior status; bulkStatus deduplicates IDs, locks all targets ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE, fails the whole batch with 404 if any target is missing, skips rows already at the target status, and writes real before/after audit rows where the backup wrote before:null. sanitizePayload gained real validation and the React list gained a useRef sequence counter that discards stale refreshes and keeps the draft on a failed save. Four real HTTP tests assert audit contents and unchanged history counts. The representative of a five-project clone family; do this one only.

name: newcodexJS/19-realtime-chat-platform
top_fix: Drop astraupskill/ and point learners two ways: archive/restore/bulk-audit to project 16, chat CRUD with real membership authorization to project 12.
